content: Wakati Waamuzi walipotawala Israeli, kulikuwa na njaa katika nchi. Mtu mmoja kutoka nchi ya Bethlehemu ya Yuda, pamoja na mke wake na wanawe wawili, akaenda kuishi katika nchi ya Moabu.

teaching.description: SAFARI YA ELIMELEKI NA FAMILIA YAKE KUELEKEA MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu Utanulizi, 1:1-9

content: Mtu huyu aliitwa Elimeleki, mkewe aliitwa Naomi, na hao wanawe wawili waliitwa Maloni na Kilioni. Walikuwa Waefrathi kutoka Bethlehemu ya Yuda. Wakaenda katika nchi ya Moabu, wakaishi huko.

teaching.description: SAFARI YA ELIMELEKI NA FAMILIA YAKE KUELEKEA MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu Utanulizi, 1:1-9

content: Elimeleki mumewe Naomi akafa, hivyo Naomi akabaki na wanawe wawili.

teaching.description: SAFARI YA ELIMELEKI NA FAMILIA YAKE KUELEKEA MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu Utanulizi, 1:1-9

content: Nao wakaoa wanawake Wamoabu, jina la mmoja aliitwa Orpa, na wa pili aliitwa Ruthu. Baada ya kama miaka kumi,

teaching.description: SAFARI YA ELIMELEKI NA FAMILIA YAKE KUELEKEA MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu Utanulizi, 1:1-9

content: Maloni na Kilioni pia wakafa. Basi Naomi akabaki hana mume wala wanawe wawili.

teaching.description: SAFARI YA ELIMELEKI NA FAMILIA YAKE KUELEKEA MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu Utanulizi, 1:1-9

content: Aliposikia akiwa huko Moabu kwamba Bwana amewasaidia watu wake kwa kuwapa chakula, Naomi na wakweze wakajiandaa kurudi nyumbani.

teaching.description: SAFARI YA ELIMELEKI NA FAMILIA YAKE KUELEKEA MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu Utanulizi, 1:1-9

content: Yeye na wakweze wawili wakaondoka pale walipokuwa wakiishi na kushika njia kurudi nchi ya Yuda.

teaching.description: SAFARI YA ELIMELEKI NA FAMILIA YAKE KUELEKEA MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu Utanulizi, 1:1-9

content: Ndipo Naomi akawaambia wale wakwe zake wawili, “Rudini, kila mmoja wenu nyumbani kwa mama yake. Bwana na awatendee fadhili kama mlivyowatendea hao waliofariki, na pia mimi.

teaching.description: SAFARI YA ELIMELEKI NA FAMILIA YAKE KUELEKEA MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu Utanulizi, 1:1-9

content:
Bwana na amjalie kila mmoja wenu maisha mema nyumbani kwa mume mwingine.”
    Kisha akawabusu, nao wakalia kwa sauti kubwa,

teaching.description: SAFARI YA ELIMELEKI NA FAMILIA YAKE KUELEKEA MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu Utanulizi, 1:1-9

content: wakamwambia, “Tutarudi pamoja na wewe nyumbani kwa watu wako.”

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: Lakini Naomi akasema, “Rudini nyumbani, binti zangu. Kwa nini mnifuate? Je, mimi nitaweza tena kuwa na wana wengine ambao wataweza kuwaoa ninyi?

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: Rudini nyumbani, binti zangu; mimi ni mzee kiasi kwamba siwezi kumpata mume mwingine. Hata kama ningefikiria kuwa bado kuna tumaini kwangu, hata kama ningekuwa na mume usiku huu na kuwazaa wana,

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: je, mngesubiri mpaka wakue? Mngebakia bila kuolewa mkiwasubiri? La, hasha, binti zangu. Nimepata uchungu kuliko ninyi, kwa sababu mkono wa Bwana umekuwa kinyume nami!”

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: Kisha wakalia tena kwa sauti. Orpa akambusu mama mkwe wake, akaenda zake, lakini Ruthu akaambatana naye.

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: Naomi akamwambia, “Tazama, mwenzako anarejea kwa watu wake na kwa miungu yake. Rudi pamoja naye.”

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: Lakini Ruthu akajibu, “Usinisihi nikuache au niache kukufuata. Utakakokwenda nami nitakwenda, na wewe utakapoishi nitaishi. Watu wako watakuwa watu wangu, na Mungu wako atakuwa Mungu wangu.

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: Pale utakapofia nami nitafia hapo, na papo hapo nitazikwa. Bwana na aniadhibu vikali, kama kitu kingine chochote kitanitenga nawe isipokuwa kifo.”

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: Naomi alipotambua kwamba Ruthu amenuia kufuatana naye, hakuendelea kumsihi tena.

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: Kwa hiyo hao wanawake wawili wakaondoka, wakafika Bethlehemu. Walipofika Bethlehemu, mji mzima ulitaharuki, wanawake wakashangaa, wakasema, “Huyu aweza kuwa ni Naomi?”

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: Akawaambia, “Msiniite tena Naomi, niiteni Mara, kwa sababu Mwenyezi amenitendea mambo machungu sana.

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: Mimi niliondoka hali nimejaa, lakini Bwana amenirudisha mtupu. Kwa nini kuniita Naomi? Bwana amenitendea mambo machungu; Mwenyezi ameniletea msiba.”

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: Kwa hiyo Naomi alirudi pamoja na Ruthu Mmoabu mkwe wake, nao wakafika Bethlehemu mwanzoni mwa kuvuna shayiri.

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: Basi Naomi alikuwa na jamaa wa upande wa mume wake, kutoka ukoo wa Elimeleki, mtu maarufu ambaye aliitwa Boazi.

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content:
Ruthu, Mmoabu, akamwambia Naomi, “Nitakwenda mashambani nikaokote mabaki ya nafaka nyuma ya yule nitakayepata kibali machoni pake.”
    Naomi akamwambia, “Nenda, binti yangu.”

teaching.description: NAOMI ASIHI WAKWEZE KURUDI KWAO MOABU
teaching.name: Ruthu 1:10-2:2

content: Basi akaenda, akaokota mabaki ya nafaka mashambani nyuma ya wavunaji. Ikatokea kwamba alijikuta anafanya kazi kwenye shamba lililokuwa mali ya Boazi, ambaye alitoka kwenye ukoo wa Elimeleki.

teaching.description: UKARIMU WA BOAZI KWA RUTHU
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:3-13

content:
Papo hapo Boazi akarudi kutoka Bethlehemu, akawasalimu wavunaji, akasema, “Bwana awe nanyi!”
    Nao wakamjibu, “Bwana akubariki.”

teaching.description: UKARIMU WA BOAZI KWA RUTHU
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:3-13

content: Boazi akamuuliza msimamizi wa wavunaji, “Je, yule mwanamwali ni wa nani?”

teaching.description: UKARIMU WA BOAZI KWA RUTHU
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:3-13

content: Msimamizi akamjibu, “Ni yule Mmoabu aliyerudi kutoka nchi ya Moabu pamoja na Naomi.

teaching.description: UKARIMU WA BOAZI KWA RUTHU
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:3-13

content: Yeye aliomba, ‘Tafadhali niruhusu niokote na kukusanya miongoni mwa miganda nyuma ya wavunaji.’ Naye ameshinda shambani tangu asubuhi pasipo kupumzika, isipokuwa kwa muda mfupi kivulini.”

teaching.description: UKARIMU WA BOAZI KWA RUTHU
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:3-13

content: Kisha Boazi akamwambia Ruthu, “Binti yangu, nisikilize. Usiende kuokota mabaki ya mavuno katika shamba lingine, na usiondoke hapa. Kaa hapa na hawa watumishi wangu wa kike.

teaching.description: UKARIMU WA BOAZI KWA RUTHU
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:3-13

content: Angalia shamba wanaume wanamovuna, ufuate nyuma yao. Nimewaamuru wanaume hawa wasikuguse. Wakati wowote ukiona kiu, nenda kwenye mitungi ukanywe maji waliyoyateka wanaume hawa.”

teaching.description: UKARIMU WA BOAZI KWA RUTHU
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:3-13

content: Kwa ajili ya hili, akasujudu mpaka nchi, akamwambia, “Jinsi gani nimepata kibali machoni pako, hata ukanijali mimi mgeni?”

teaching.description: UKARIMU WA BOAZI KWA RUTHU
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:3-13

content: Boazi akamjibu, “Nimeambiwa yote uliyomtendea mama mkwe wako tangu mume wako alipofariki, na jinsi ulivyomwacha baba yako na mama yako na nchi yako ulimozaliwa, ukaja kuishi na watu ambao hukuwafahamu awali.

teaching.description: UKARIMU WA BOAZI KWA RUTHU
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:3-13

content: Bwana na akulipe kwa yale uliyoyatenda. Ubarikiwe kwa wingi na Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, ambaye umekimbilia mabawani mwake.”

teaching.description: UKARIMU WA BOAZI KWA RUTHU
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:3-13

content: Kisha Ruthu akasema, “Naomba niendelee kupata kibali machoni pako, bwana wangu. Kwa maana umenifariji na umezungumza kwa ukarimu na mjakazi wako, hata ingawa mimi si bora kama mmoja wa watumishi wako wa kike.”

teaching.description: UKARIMU WA BOAZI KWA RUTHU
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:3-13

content:
Wakati wa chakula, Boazi akamwambia Ruthu, “Karibia hapa. Kula mkate na uchovye ndani ya siki.”
    Alipoketi pamoja na wavunaji, akampa nafaka zilizookwa. Akala kiasi alichotaka na kusaza.

teaching.description: RUTHU AFADHILIWA ZAIDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:14-23

content: Alipoinuka ili kuokota mabaki ya nafaka, Boazi akawaagiza watu wake, “Hata kama atakusanya kati ya miganda, msimzuie.

teaching.description: RUTHU AFADHILIWA ZAIDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:14-23

content: Badala yake, toeni masuke katika miganda, mwachieni ayaokote, na msimkemee.”

teaching.description: RUTHU AFADHILIWA ZAIDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:14-23

content: Basi Ruthu akaokota masazo shambani hata jioni. Akatwanga ile shayiri aliyokusanya, ikajaa efa moja.

teaching.description: RUTHU AFADHILIWA ZAIDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:14-23

content: Akaibeba na kuelekea mjini, naye mama mkwe wake akaona jinsi alivyoweza kuokota nafaka nyingi. Pia Ruthu akachukua kile alichobakiza baada ya kula na kushiba, akampa.

teaching.description: RUTHU AFADHILIWA ZAIDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:14-23

content:
Basi mkwewe akamuuliza, “Je, umeokota wapi leo? Umefanya kazi wapi? Abarikiwe mtu yule aliyekujali.”
    Ndipo Ruthu akamwambia mama mkwe wake juu ya yule ambaye yeye alikuwa amefanyia kazi katika shamba lake. Akasema, “Yule mtu niliyefanyia kazi kwake leo, anaitwa Boazi.”

teaching.description: RUTHU AFADHILIWA ZAIDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:14-23

content: Naye Naomi akamwambia mkwewe, “Bwana ambariki! Hakuacha kuonyesha fadhili zake kwa walio hai na kwa waliokufa.” Pia akamwambia, “Huyo mtu ni mmoja wa jamaa yetu wa karibu anayestahili kutukomboa.”

teaching.description: RUTHU AFADHILIWA ZAIDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:14-23

content: Kisha Ruthu, Mmoabu, akasema, “Hata aliniambia, ‘Kaa pamoja na watumishi wangu mpaka watakapomaliza kuvuna nafaka yangu yote.’ ”

teaching.description: RUTHU AFADHILIWA ZAIDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:14-23

content: Kisha Naomi akamwambia Ruthu mkwewe, “Binti yangu, itakuwa vyema wewe ufuatane na wasichana wake, kwa sababu katika shamba la mtu mwingine wanaweza kukudhuru.”

teaching.description: RUTHU AFADHILIWA ZAIDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:14-23

content: Kwa hivyo Ruthu akafuatana na watumishi wa kike wa Boazi, akaokota mpaka mwisho wa mavuno ya shayiri na ya ngano. Naye aliishi na mama mkwe wake.

teaching.description: RUTHU AFADHILIWA ZAIDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 2:14-23

content: Kisha Naomi akamwambia mkwewe, “Binti yangu, je, nisingelikutafutia pumziko ambako utatunzika vyema?

teaching.description: MATUKIO KATIKA KIWANJA CHA KUPURIA NGANO CHA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:1-3

content: Je, Boazi, ambaye umekuwa pamoja na watumishi wake wasichana, si jamaa yetu wa karibu? Usiku wa leo atakuwa anapepeta ngano kwenye sakafu ya kupuria.

teaching.description: MATUKIO KATIKA KIWANJA CHA KUPURIA NGANO CHA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:1-3

content: Basi oga na ukajipake marashi, ujivalie nguo zako nzuri. Kisha uende kwenye sakafu ya kupuria, lakini angalia asijue kwamba upo pale mpaka atakapomaliza kula na kunywa.

teaching.description: MATUKIO KATIKA KIWANJA CHA KUPURIA NGANO CHA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:1-3

content: Atakapokwenda kulala, angalia mahali atakapolala. Kisha uende ufunue miguu yake, ulale. Naye atakuambia utakalofanya.”

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content: Ruthu akajibu, “Lolote usemalo nitatenda.”

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content: Basi akashuka mpaka kwenye sakafu ya kupuria, akafanya kila kitu mama mkwe wake alichomwambia kufanya.

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content: Wakati Boazi alipomaliza kula na kunywa, naye akawa amejawa na furaha, alikwenda kulala mwisho wa lundo la nafaka. Ruthu akanyemelea polepole, akafunua miguu yake, na akalala.

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content: Usiku wa manane, kitu kilimshtua Boazi, akajigeuza, akagundua yupo mwanamke amelala miguuni pake.

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content:
Akauliza, “Wewe ni nani?”
    Akajibu, “Ni mimi Ruthu, mjakazi wako. Uitande nguo yako juu yangu, kwa sababu wewe ndiwe jamaa wa karibu wa kutukomboa.”

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content: Akamwambia, “Binti yangu, ubarikiwe na Bwana. Wema huu wa sasa ni mkuu kushinda hata ule ulioonyesha mwanzoni. Hukuwakimbilia vijana, wakiwa matajiri au maskini.

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content: Sasa, binti yangu, usiogope. Nitakufanyia yote uliyoomba. Kwa maana mji wote wa watu wangu wanakujua ya kwamba wewe ni mwanamke mwenye tabia nzuri.

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content: Ingawa ni kweli kwamba mimi ndiye jamaa aliye karibu, bado kuna mtu mwingine wa jamaa aliye karibu zaidi wa kukomboa kuliko mimi.

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content: Wewe kaa hapa usiku huu, kisha asubuhi kama akikubali kukomboa, vyema na akomboe. La sivyo kama hayuko tayari, hakika kama Bwana aishivyo nitafanya hivyo. Lala hapa mpaka asubuhi.”

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content: Hivyo huyo mwanamke akalala miguuni pake mpaka asubuhi, akaondoka mapema pasipo mtu kuweza kumtambua mwenzake, maana Boazi alisema, “Isijulikane kabisa ya kuwa mwanamke alifika kwenye sakafu ya kupuria.”

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content: Pia akamwambia, “Leta shela yako uliyoivaa, uitandaze.” Naye alipoitandaza, akamimina vipimo sita vya shayiri, akamtwika. Kisha Ruthu akarudi zake mjini.

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content:
Basi Ruthu alipofika kwa mama mkwe wake Naomi, akamuuliza, “Je, binti yangu, ilikuwaje huko?”
    Ndipo akamwelezea kila kitu Boazi alichomfanyia.

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content: Akaendelea kusema, “Amenipa shayiri vipimo sita akisema, ‘Usiende kwa mama mkwe wako mikono mitupu.’ ”

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content: Kisha Naomi akasema, “Subiri binti yangu, mpaka utakapojua kwamba hili jambo limekwendaje. Kwa sababu mtu huyu hatatulia mpaka akamilishe jambo hili leo.”

teaching.description: MAJIBU YA BOAZI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:4-18

content: Boazi akakwea mpaka kwenye lango la mji, akaketi pale. Yule mtu wa jamaa aliyekuwa wa karibu wa kukomboa, ambaye Boazi alimtaja, akaja. Boazi akasema, “Njoo hapa, rafiki yangu. Karibu uketi.” Naye akakaribia, akaketi.

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Boazi akatwaa watu kumi miongoni mwa wazee wa mji, akawaambia, “Ketini hapa.” Nao wakaketi.

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Kisha akamwambia yule jamaa wa karibu wa kukomboa, “Naomi, aliyerudi hapa kutoka nchi ya Moabu, anauza sehemu ya ardhi iliyokuwa mali ya ndugu yetu Elimeleki.

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content:
Nami niliwaza nikujulishe wewe na kukuambia uinunue mbele ya hawa waliopo hapa, na mbele ya wazee wa watu wangu. Kama wewe utaikomboa, haya fanya hivyo. Lakini kama hutaikomboa, uniambie, ili nijue. Kwa kuwa hakuna mtu mwingine mwenye haki ya kuikomboa ila wewe na baada yako ni mimi.”
    Naye akasema, “Nitaikomboa mimi.”

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Ndipo Boazi akasema “Siku utakaponunua hiyo ardhi kutoka kwa Naomi na Ruthu, Mmoabu, itakubidi kumchukua pia huyo mjane, ili kudumisha jina la marehemu pamoja na mali yake.”

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Aliposikia hili, yule jamaa wa karibu wa kukomboa akasema, “Basi mimi sitaweza kuikomboa, kwa sababu inaonekana nitauhatarisha urithi wangu. Wewe ikomboe mwenyewe. Mimi sitaweza.”

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: (Basi katika siku za kale huko Israeli, ili kukamilisha tendo la kukomboa na kukabidhiana mali, mmoja huvua kiatu chake na kumpatia mwingine. Hii ilikuwa ni njia ya kuhalalisha mabadilishano katika Israeli.)

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Basi yule jamaa wa karibu wa kukomboa akamwambia Boazi, “Wewe inunue mwenyewe.” Naye huyo jamaa akavua kiatu chake.

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Kisha Boazi akawatangazia wazee na watu wote waliokuwepo, “Leo ninyi ni mashahidi kwamba mimi nimenunua kutoka kwa Naomi yote yaliyokuwa mali ya Elimeleki, Kilioni na Maloni.

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Nimemchukua pia Ruthu, Mmoabu, mjane wa Maloni, awe mke wangu, ili kuendeleza jina la marehemu pamoja na mali zake, ili jina lake marehemu lisitoweke miongoni mwa jamaa yake, wala katika kumbukumbu za mji wake. Leo hivi ninyi ni mashahidi!”

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Kisha wazee pamoja na watu wote waliokuwa langoni wakasema, “Sisi ni mashahidi. Bwana na amfanye mwanamke huyu aingiaye nyumbani mwako kuwa kama Raheli na kama Lea, wale wanawake wawili ambao pamoja waliijenga nyumba ya Israeli. Nawe ufanikiwe katika Efrathi na uwe mashuhuri katika Bethlehemu.

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Kupitia kwa watoto ambao Bwana atakupa kutokana na huyu mwanamwali, jamaa yako na ifanane na ya Peresi, ambaye Tamari alimzalia Yuda.”

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Basi Boazi akamwoa Ruthu, naye akawa mke wake. Alipoingia kwake, Bwana akamjalia Ruthu, naye akapata mimba, akamzaa mtoto wa kiume.

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Wanawake wakamwambia Naomi: “Ahimidiwe Bwana, asiyekuacha bila kuwa na jamaa wa karibu wa kukomboa. Na awe mashuhuri katika Israeli yote!

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Atakurejeshea uhai wako na kukuangalia katika siku za uzee wako. Kwa maana mkweo ambaye anakupenda, na ambaye kwako ni bora zaidi ya watoto wa kiume saba, ndiye alimzaa.”

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Basi Naomi akamchukua yule mtoto, akampakata na akawa mlezi wake.

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content: Wanawake waliokuwa jirani zake wakasema, “Naomi ana mtoto wa kiume.” Wakamwita jina lake Obedi. Yeye ndiye baba yake Yese, aliye baba yake Daudi.

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content:
Hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Peresi:
    
    Peresi alimzaa Hesroni,

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content:
Hesroni akamzaa Ramu,
    Ramu akamzaa Aminadabu,

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content:
Aminadabu akamzaa Nashoni,
    Nashoni akamzaa Salmoni,

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content:
Salmoni akamzaa Boazi,
    Boazi akamzaa Obedi,

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22

content:
Obedi akamzaa Yese,
    na Yese akamzaa Daudi.

teaching.description: BOAZI AMWOA RUTHU NA KUJALIWA MTOTO OBEDI
teaching.name: Ruthu 3:18-4:22
